newsitem.title: LATVIA: Unibanka gains on rising Latvian bourse.
newsitem.headline: Unibanka gains on rising Latvian bourse.

text.p: Shares in leading bank Unibanka gained slightly on the Latvian bourse on Wednesday, mirroring gains throughout the market, the stock exchange said.
Unibanka rose to 2.33 lats from 2.31 lats and traded 12,349 lats out of the total market turnover of 73,091 lats.
Other official list stock Riga Transport Fleet was ahead on trade of 15,000 lats as it remained stable at one lat.
Confectionery maker Staburadze showed small activity but rose to 1.82 lats from 1.59 lats. Demand was again high at 94,985 shares compared with supply of just 932.
On the secondary market, the Daugavpils chain firm rose to 1.16 lats from 1.10 lats on turnover of 29,754 lats, the most active stock on the secondary market.
Other active shares included the Lode Brick company on trade of 3,736 lats as it was stable at 1.02 lats while the Salacgriva '95 firm traded 2,760 lats and added 20 santimes to 2.30 lats.
The Veldze soft drinks firm turned over 2,720 lats and was unchanged at 68 santimes while the Kaija fish cannery was one of the few to fall, dipping to 1.19 lats from 1.20 on business of 2,677 lats.
